commit.message:
Feat: EBS tags and encryption (#34)

* Update OneLens Agent and Deployer to version 1.3.0 with new features and improvements

- Bump onelens-agent and onelens-deployer versions to 1.3.0.
- Change onelens-agent image tag to v1.3.0 and update related configurations.
- Modify storage class reclaim policy to 'Delete' and enable volume tags with application metadata.
- Introduce EBS encryption and tagging options in the deployment scripts.
- Update install.sh to reflect new version and streamline environment variable setup.
- Remove outdated index.yaml files for both charts.

This release includes enhancements for EBS tags and encryption, improving deployment flexibility and resource management.

* Refactor entrypoint.sh and install.sh for improved error handling and script execution

- Update entrypoint.sh to include success and failure messages for script execution.
- Modify install.sh to enhance error logging and preserve original exit codes.
- Adjust script permissions for entrypoint.sh to ensure executable status.
- Clean up commented-out code in install.sh for better readability and maintainability.
